create.name: Ira Trivedi
create.bio:
Ira Trivedi is a yoga acharya and writer who lives in Mumbai, where she teaches classical hatha yoga, pranayama and yin yoga from the Yog Love studio on the Versova seafront. Before turning to yoga full time she studied economics at Wellesley College and took an MBA at Columbia, and she has since written eight books, from novels and a study of changing attitudes to marriage in India to children's yoga titles featuring Om the Yoga Dog. She presented yoga programmes on Doordarshan and India Today, and was among the organisers of the first International Day of Yoga gathering in New Delhi in 2015.

Her teaching keeps to the traditional pairing of posture, breath and meditation, with the Bhagavad Gita and Patanjali's Yoga Sutras as the philosophical ground. Students can join her in person in Mumbai, follow live and recorded classes online, or train with her on Yog Love's teacher-training and pranayama courses. She also leads residential retreats around India, and through the Namami Yoga Foundation, the charity she set up, she brings yoga and life-skills classes to children from poorer families.

courses.title: 200 hour Yoga Teacher Training Course with Ira Trivedi
courses.description: An online teacher training run over weekends, with live sessions on Zoom and recorded lessons for daily practice in between. It covers asana, pranayama, meditation and an introduction to the Yoga Sutras and the Bhagavad Gita, and leads to a Yoga Alliance RYT 200 certificate.

courses.title: Pranayama Coach with Ira Trivedi
courses.description: A self-paced online course in yogic breathing, with recorded video and audio lessons, study notes and a final exam. It works through the main pranayama techniques, kriyas and bandhas and how to teach them to others, ending in a Yoga Alliance-recognised certificate.

courses.title: At Home with Ira
courses.description: A monthly library of recordings of Ira's live Zoom classes, from hatha and yin sessions to pranayama and meditation. It also includes her 21-day pranayama and meditation programmes and suits beginners and intermediate students practising at home.

courses.title: Kerala Yoga Retreat
courses.description: A New Year residential retreat with Ira on the Kerala coast near Paravoor. Days combine yoga, pranayama and meditation with an introduction to Kerala's Ayurvedic traditions; meals and lodging are included.
